name: CubCrafters XCub
summary: Modern, factory-built evolution of the classic tandem bush plane with a bigger engine, a roomier cabin and oversized tires.

wings: High wing braced by a V-strut on each side
Large flaps along the trailing edge
engines: Single Lycoming flat-four (180-215 hp) in a deep, bulky cowl
fuselage: Enclosed tandem two-seat cabin with doors
Fixed tailwheel gear with oversized balloon tires
tail: Conventional tail with straight-edged fin and rudder

tellTales: Classic tandem bush-plane shape on V-struts but with a bulkier nose
Oversized balloon tires on a tailwheel airframe
Deep cowl and big prop on a small, narrow-fuselage airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The Super Cub has a slimmer nose, smaller tires and a narrower cabin; this one looks beefier with a deeper cowl and much bigger tires.
A Maule has side-by-side seating and a boxier cabin on a single lift strut; this has tandem seats on V-struts.
The Husky has a wider, squarer cabin and tall squared tail on a single strut; this has V-struts on a slimmer, more traditional fuselage.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
